body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Brother presented its all-in-one fax machine ''intelliFAX 1960c'' during CES 2007.
It features 33.6K bps Super G3 fax modem, 16 MB fax memory and usb interface for future color printing. It also supports color inkjet fax, copier and digital cordless phone.
